title: Dental charts in noctune — web (early preview)

headline: Dental charts.
Early preview.
scenes.narration: This is an early preview of dental charting in noctune. Every chart in this video comes from a sample dictation, read by a synthetic voice. No real patients.

headline: Pick Dental Procedure.
The chart comes too.
scenes.narration: Record the dental exam the way you dictate it now. Choose the Dental Procedure template, and the New Encounter drawer adds a dental chart. With any other template, add it with the Add button.

headline: A dictated
dental exam.
scenes.narration: Here is Murphy's sample exam. Press play to hear it.

headline: Every tooth,
drawn and in words.
scenes.narration: noctune writes the note, then the Dental Chart tab. The mouth is drawn tooth by tooth, with each quadrant listed beside it in words. A tooth nobody mentioned stays uncharted. Where noctune is unsure, it flags the tooth for you instead of guessing.

headline: Hear what
was said.
scenes.narration: Click a flagged tooth to open it. The transcript heard one of four, here. Press play on the quote to hear it.

headline: You decide.
Then it's reviewed.
scenes.narration: It was one-oh-four. Tick Reviewed, and save. Confirm chart stays off until every flag has been looked at.

headline: Cats too.
Compare visits.
scenes.narration: Cats work the same way. Tigger had a chart last year, so today's can be compared with it. Teeth that got worse, newly extracted, or newly missing are marked, with a summary above the chart.

headline: Confirm it.
Then download.
scenes.narration: When you've checked the chart, confirm it. Download it as a PDF or an image. Until a chart is confirmed, every download is marked as a draft.

headline: Early preview.
Your feedback counts.
instructionCard: Dogs and cats only, adult teeth
A draft until you review and confirm it
Check flagged teeth against the audio
Tell us what your charts need to show
scenes.narration: Dental charting is an early preview. It covers dogs and cats, and every chart is a draft until you review and confirm it. Tooth numbers can be misheard, so check flagged teeth against the recording. We'd like to hear what your charts need to show.

headline: Try it
in early preview.
scenes.narration: noctune. Dental charts, in early preview.
